Met confirms that only two panel paintings are certainly attributable to Michelino, rather than saying only two works of all media are extant. The rejected suitors' comic gestures and compact layout are the curator's interpretation; authorship of theological emotions is not assumed.
No primary or secondary emotion in the original record. The symbolic marriage and wit do not justify assigning modern love or joy automatically.
Existing PR #3 Japanese prose preserves Met's confirmed number of panel paintings, surface damage and humor in rejected suitors without long literal translation. No meaningful rewrite required.
